sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Added featured-image ratio controls for sermon lists.
  • Improved sermon image sizing and layout.
  • Added two-line sermon descriptions and streamlined metadata.
  • Updated the Sermon Theme 1 preview image.
  • Improved Sermon Theme 1 appearance display.
  • Renamed the main submenu to Shortcodes.
  • Updated shortcode documentation.
  • Made Single Event buttons optional.
  • Added event color controls across Events Elementor widgets.
  • Added responsive event-title typography controls.
  • Improved asset cache-busting for immediate style updates.
  • Performance and code optimization.
